---
title: "Penguin Analysis in R"
author: "Ceilidh Torrance"
date: 2026-09-21
---

Data: [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/),
Palmer Station Antarctica LTER.

```{r}
library(palmerpenguins)
library(tidyverse)

penguins <- penguins

head(penguins)
summary(penguins)
```

```{r}
avg_mass <- penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(
    mean_body_mass = mean(body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

avg_mass
```
